description: Every individual order line, the most detailed sales data. Use this whenever the question needs orders, average order value, cost, profit, margin, fulfilment location or country. It is the slowest of the sales datasets, so prefer daily_sales or monthly_sales for plain revenue trends.

pv.join: JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.shopify_variant_id = oli.shopify_variant_id

p.join: JOIN products p ON p.shopify_product_id = pv.shopify_product_id

loc.join: LEFT JOIN inventory_locations loc ON loc.shopify_location_id = oli.shopify_location_id

gross_revenue.description: Sales value before discounts and refunds

net_revenue.description: Sales value after discounts and refunds. This is the usual meaning of revenue

profit.sql: oli.price * oli.quantity - COALESCE(oli.total_discount, 0) - COALESCE(oli.refunded_amount, 0) - COALESCE(oli.unit_cost, 0) * oli.quantity
profit.description: Net revenue minus cost of goods

product_count.description: How many different products were sold

variant_count.description: How many different variants were sold

average_order_value.description: Net revenue per order. Cannot be broken down by product, variant or sku, because one order can contain several products

average_unit_price.description: Average price paid per unit before discounts

margin.description: Profit as a fraction of net revenue. 0.42 means 42 percent

product.description: The product's own name, which is what people usually mean when they name an item. Anything that looks like a full item name belongs here, not in vendor.

product_type.description: Product category as set in Shopify

vendor.description: The brand or manufacturer on its own, never a full item name. If the text has more words than a brand would, it is a product, not a vendor.

product_status.description: Shopify product status, for example active or archived

variant.description: Full variant name, which contains the colour and the size, for example 'Black/Gold / 27.5CM/9UK/10US/43EUR'

size_label.description: Shoe size as written, for example '27.5CM'. Empty for products that have no size. Use this to group by size

size_cm.description: Shoe size in centimetres as a number, for example 27.5. Use this to compare sizes, for example smaller than 24

unit_price.description: Price of one unit on the order line, in rupees. Use this to filter by price, for example under 15000

location.description: Warehouse or store the order was fulfilled from

financial_status.description: Payment state, for example paid, pending or refunded

fulfillment_status.description: Shipping state, for example fulfilled or unfulfilled

order_date.description: Date the order was placed. Optional grain: day, week, month, year
